item.title: [Critique] CVE-2026-110936 — Siemens Software Center Uncontrolled Search Path Element Vulnerability
item.description: Siemens Software Center contains an uncontrolled search path element vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.

item.title: [Critique] CVE-2026-96652 — Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
item.description: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

item.title: [Critique] CVE-2026-96654 — Plex Media Server Improper Neutralization of Encoded URI Schemes in a Web Page Vulnerability
item.description: Plex Media Server contains an improper neutralization of encoded URI schemes in a web page vulnerability that could allow an attacker to call other plugins' functions and supply their own parameters. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

item.title: [Critique] CVE-2026-96655 — Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
item.description: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96656.

item.title: [Critique] CVE-2026-96656 — Plex Media Server External Control of File Name or Path Vulnerability
item.description: Plex Media Server contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability which can allow an admin user to write arbitrary files that may be executed on load. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96655.

item.title: [Critique] CVE-2026-106931 — EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition OS Command Injection Vulnerability
item.description: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on the system running the affected product.
